messages.text:
Both designs are clean. Here's the summary:

---

**Variant 1 — Navy photo left, light-blue offer right:** A dramatic split with a warm lifestyle photo of a small business owner on the left 60%, overlaid with a white card carrying the headline "Run your business, not your books" and a navy CTA. The right 40% is a bold light-blue block with the oversized "90% off" stat in navy, a product UI dashboard shot for credibility, and supporting body copy. White logo on a navy pill sits bottom-right.

**Variant 2 — Light-blue photo left, navy offer right:** Flipped colourway — same split structure but with light-blue background, the photo on the left, and a deep navy right block. The offer switches to "3 months free" in light-blue, paired with a performance-growth illustration instead of product UI, plus a mint checklist (invoicing, bank reconciliation, expense tracking) for feature proof. Light-blue logo bottom-right.

Both use the split-layout rhythm of the reference — lifestyle photo anchoring the left, bold colour block with oversized offer on the right — but interpreted entirely through Xero's palette, voice, and asset library.
